scope: offline original-G to MINI full-application boot contract

clock.normal_call_abi: No arguments; r0 returns unsigned nominal MHz; r1 clobbered; no lock or write.
integration: Multiply nonzero MHz by 1000000 after checking <=2147 for signed-Hz delay arithmetic.
Use G GPIO helpers; do not recursively acquire their bank spinlock.
Require PA1/2 ownership and stable clocks for the complete codec transaction.

patch.name: mini_absent_boot_extensions
patch.rationale: MINI has no SDRAM or secondary application. Initialize G's private SDRAM_CFG_INFO/EX_APP_INFO to zero instead of copying unspecified incoming boot-context bytes+80..91. Preserve core boot info and mailbox.

calibration.normalization: Only explicitly listed absolute globals/callees and local branch instruction indices; no MMIO/register/opcode masks.

recovery.preservation_scope: Keep the entire MINI VM region [0x82000,0xBE000), including the independent OTA VM/header sector at0xBC000.

conditional_vm_paths_exist: repair from the same unit backup
original_installer.evidence: build_target bytecode 42..62 copies current, 250..286 replaces APP_AREA; VM and USR writes are explicit separate branches; plan_sectors rejects changes outside allowed ranges.

recovery_button_audit.RESET_parser_stores: Parsed pin, level, duration bytes into descriptor+48/+49/+50 at0x01C03AB6/3AC8/3ADC; this fragment does not sample GPIO or branch to recovery.
recovery_button_audit.manual_result: No recovery/power-on combination found; A+B and B+C describe runtime BT/tuner controls.

marker_guard.would_only_cover: Failures after marker store followed by a reset retaining RAM.

next_proofs: Prove a MINI recovery trigger with stock flash intact before installing a full image.
If using USB_KEY: force ROM at power-on, identify4C4A:8057, run read-only RAM diagnostics, then verify normal return and unchanged backup hashes.
If using staged OTA: separately prove the MINI updater can start without the normal application and identify ota-TANK MINI; this is not the ROM SCSI protocol.
Before any writer: review sector allowlist, verify preserved SPL/OTA/VM/BTIF/key_mac, and prepare exact readback/rollback for this unit.
A valid-image hang additionally requires proven independent trigger or early retained marker plus a hardware-tested watchdog; a USB soft key is insufficient.

references.role: Documentary ABI field names/sizes; not needed for offline execution.
